summary: Add a nullable column with a filling trigger, backfill, deploy, retire, then re-check and require it.

stages.description: A BEFORE trigger fills the value for rows written by the old version.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean
CREATE TRIGGER migproto_opt_in_default BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION migproto_opt_in_default()
WITH batch AS (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL LIMIT 2000) UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false FROM batch WHERE account_user.id = batch.id

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Re-check for NULLs, require the column, remove the trigger.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = false WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL
ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL
